At most one of the following points lies on that corridor. Which one?
(A) (0.4894, 0.7780)
(B) (0.7818, 0.6783)
(C) (0.9107, 0.7473)
(D) None of the above points lies on the directly drivable corridor.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
